segments.text: V. 16. This is one Reaſon. It is not a proper Time for them to faſt. Another is, they are not ripe for it. New cloth—The Words in the Original properly ſignify, Cloth that hath not paſſed thro' the Fuller's Hands, and which is conſequently much harſher, than what has been waſhed and worn; and therefore yielding leſs than that, will tear away the Edges to which it is ſewed.
